preconditions.expression: len(N_K) == 2 and len(A) == N and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in N_K) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two integers N and K on the first line, followed by N space-separated integers in the array A.
N is between 2 and 100000 inclusive, and K is between 0 and min(10, N-2) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-1e9 <= x <= 1e9 for x in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in A is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(result_array) == N and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in result_array)
postconditions.description: Output is a single line containing exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result_array[i] == a0 + i * d for i in range(N)) for some a0, d
postconditions.description: The output array is an arithmetic progression defined by a0 and d.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(N) if result_array[i] != A[i]) <= K
postconditions.description: The output array differs from the input array in at most K elements.

postconditions.expression: not any((a0_alt < a0) or (a0_alt == a0 and d_alt < d) for a0_alt, d_alt in possible_progressions if (a0_alt, d_alt) != (a0, d))
postconditions.description: The chosen arithmetic progression (a0, d) is the most beautiful among all possible valid progressions, where beauty is defined as (a0 < b0) or (a0 == b0 and d < d1).
